whisper_prompt: Claude Code, Kubai, icons, skill file, Opus 5.5, React, Vue, HTML.

lines.text: Bro, Claude can now draw every icon in your app. Animated. One style. From one sentence.
lines.direction: hyped confident bro hook, bright energy, punchy, each short phrase lands hard
lines.show: Bro. Claude can now draw every icon in your app. Animated. One style. From one sentence.

lines.text: A dev called Koo-bye wrote one whole style down in a skill file. That skill has already drawn over twenty-eight hundred icons. All free.
lines.direction: casual storyteller bro giving proof, impressed and rising on twenty-eight hundred, grinning on All free
lines.show: A dev called Kubai wrote one whole style down in a skill file. That skill has already drawn over 2,800 icons. All free.

lines.text: Here's how this shit works, and how you use it.
lines.direction: relaxed confident invitation, casual, a little cheeky on this shit

lines.text: Ask A.I. for an icon twice, and you get two different styles. What the fuck is this?
lines.direction: casual and knowing, then comic disbelief, emphatic and funny on What the fuck is this
lines.show: Ask AI for an icon twice, and you get two different styles. What the fuck is this?

lines.text: So how does it draw a folder and a lock that look like one guy made both?
lines.direction: genuinely curious bro, leaning in, rising question

lines.text: Alright, let's cook. Every icon is built like a folder. Back piece. White sheet. Front piece.
lines.direction: relaxed confident bro energy, hyped on let's cook, then a clear beat of silence after each of the three pieces

lines.text: Next, every piece gets a fat outline on the outside, so the shape never shrinks.
lines.direction: casual clear teacher bro, steady, punch on fat outline and on outside

lines.text: Then one color paints the whole thing. Light, dark, shadow, all from that one color.
lines.direction: casual clear teacher bro, a little wonder, quick list rhythm on light, dark, shadow

lines.text: Last, every part gets two poses. Rest and hover. That's the whole fucking trick.
lines.direction: casual and simple, a beat before Rest and hover, amused deadpan on the last sentence

lines.text: So style is not taste, bro. It's a list of rules. A skill.
lines.direction: quiet knowing tone, then a satisfied reveal, slower and warmer on A skill

lines.text: Same layers. Same outline. Same light.
lines.direction: crisp confident three even beats, a clear pause after each

lines.text: A folder and a lock are different things, but they follow the same rules. So they match. And they move like the real thing.
lines.direction: warm explaining bro, relief of understanding, a smile on like the real thing

lines.text: So you paste one line into Claude Code. Then you say, draw icons for my app. It draws them, checks its own screenshots, and fixes its own mess.
lines.direction: energetic and practical, quick clear steps, impressed on checks its own screenshots, amused on fixes its own mess

lines.text: The catch? It needs a strong model that can see images. Like Opus five point five.
lines.direction: honest lower tone, candid aside, short pause after The catch
lines.show: The catch? It needs a strong model that can see images. Like Opus 5.5.

lines.text: Too lazy to draw? The repo also comes with twenty-eight hundred icons, ready to use right now. Free. Link is in the description. Or comment SKILL, and I will send you detailed instructions with the repo link.
lines.direction: friendly teasing on Too lazy to draw, generous and upbeat, clear emphasis on SKILL, warm relaxed ending
lines.show: Too lazy to draw? The repo also comes with 2,800 icons, ready to use right now. Free. Link is in the description. Or comment SKILL, and I will send you detailed instructions with the repo link.
